race.title: Midnite Ain't Your Grandad's Bookie Handicap
race.verdict: NESWICK proved suited by the step up in trip when making a winning start to life in handicaps at Southwell and can defy a 2 lb weights rise with likely better still to come from this lightly-raced sort. Wolverhampton scorer Fiefdom also has relatively few miles on the clock and is feared most, while the handily-weighted Percy Jones and C&D winner Fair Dinkum can also have a say in this intriguing handicap. NESWICK FIEFDOM (IRE) PERCY JONES
